title: 第一卷 第19章 幸福第一卷 第20章 敌对
content_zh:
“呼～”
到了院子口，李乘风忍不住将背着的沉重山猪从肩膀上抖落到地上，麻袋口瞬间被震开，露出了山猪和那蟒蛇的尸体。
他呼了口气，正准备歇歇，然后让刘玉娘出来帮他把野猪抬回去，剥皮、割肉、收拾收拾，却见到两条奇异的目光。
扭头一看，隔壁的王氏和陈氏一脸见了鬼似的看着他。
见他望来，又触电似的收回，黑着脸各自从院子门口离开了，回到了自己屋里。
“见自己过得好了，捕到猎物了，她们那么不高兴？”
李乘风看着她们的神情，皱了皱眉毛，心中正想着之际，院门里面主屋的木门吱呀一声打开，满脸欢喜的刘玉娘激动地从屋里跑出来。
“乘风，你回来了！”
刘玉娘神情无限惊喜地从屋里飞奔而出，走到院门口，一把将院门打开，看着李乘风高兴激动地开口。
“扑~”
一边说着，伴随着独特诱人的体香涌入鼻腔，刘玉娘柔白娇嫩的身躯一把扑到了李乘风怀里，紧紧将她抱住，狠狠的呼吸，“真好，你回来了，真好。”
刘玉娘狠狠的低着声音呢喃，随后待松开手，抬起头来才发现身边放着的野猪尸体和一条大蟒蛇尸体，顿时神色错愕。
“呀，乘风，你还捕了个野猪回来，还捉了这么大一条蟒蛇！”
刘玉娘惊呼地开口，看向李乘风的目光里，欣喜不可控制地洋溢而出。
但是随后想到什么，她又收敛起来，抿着嘴拉着李乘风就要进屋，但是要抬步的时候才想起来，急忙和李乘风开口，“来，乘风，我来帮你，咱俩一起抬着这东西进去。”
“好，辛苦玉娘了。”
李乘风看着玉娘的样子，脸上露出笑容地开口，说话之间也提了口力气，蹲下来和刘玉娘一起抬着丢在地上的山猪肉与那一条蟒蛇尸体进了院子里。
到了院子之后，刘玉娘紧跟着就把院门关起来，随后走过来对着李乘风关切地开口：“乘风，渴不？我给你倒碗水喝。”
“行。”
李乘风笑着点头，他带的两葫芦水早在山里喝光，现在确实觉得口渴，刘玉娘闻言，急忙倒了碗水端过来给他。

李乘风接过水喝了，刘玉娘又给他端了一盆清水，带着毛巾来擦汗洗脸。
等收拾完，又觉得腰间热力涌动，消耗的力气又有所恢复，当即站了起来，“这猪肉得赶紧收拾了，肥膘炼油，瘦肉腌好留着，咱留些，这几天吃，这头猪可够咱俩吃上一些时日了。”
“好，我来帮你。”
刘玉娘急忙开口，听到李乘风意思不想进山，很是积极。
“不用，葫芦里的猪血你赶紧拿出来处理处理，趁早吃了。”
李乘风摇了摇头，起身去接了锅水烧，摩拳擦掌地看着野猪尸体开口，“这野猪我来处理，你等下来帮忙就行。”
“好！”
刘玉娘闻言，也是干劲十足地开口，说完话，就将猪血倒到盆里，掺上葱段净置。
等到李乘风把水烧开，将野猪皮上的毛发一烫，就拿着柴刀和他一起刮猪皮。
content_en:
"Hoo~"
When he arrived at the entrance of the yard, Li Chengfeng couldn't help but shake the heavy wild boar he was carrying from his shoulders to the ground. The mouth of the sack was instantly opened, revealing the bodies of the wild boar and the python.
He exhaled and was about to take a rest, and then asked Liu Yuniang to come out and help him carry the wild boar back, skin it, cut the meat, and clean it up, when he saw two strange eyes.
When he turned around, he saw Mrs. Wang and Mrs. Chen next door looking at him as if they had seen a ghost.
Seeing his gaze, he withdrew his gaze as if he was electrocuted. They left from the courtyard door with dark faces and returned to their own rooms.
"Seeing that they are living well and have caught prey, are they so unhappy?"
Li Chengfeng looked at their expressions and frowned. Just as he was thinking about it, the wooden door of the main room behind the courtyard gate opened with a creak, and Liu Yuniang ran out of the house excitedly with a face full of joy.
"Chengfeng, you are back!"
Liu Yuniang ran out of the house with an expression of infinite surprise, walked to the courtyard door, opened the courtyard door, and watched Li Chengfeng speak happily and excitedly.
"Pu~"
As she spoke, with the unique and alluring body fragrance pouring into her nostrils, Liu Yuniang's soft white and delicate body threw herself into Li Chengfeng's arms, hugged her tightly, and breathed hard, "It's great, you're back. It's great."
Liu Yuniang murmured in a low voice. Then she let go and raised her head to find the wild boar carcass and the carcass of a large python lying next to her. She suddenly looked shocked.
"Ah, Chengfeng, you even caught a wild boar and caught such a big python!"
Liu Yuniang exclaimed and looked at Li Chengfeng, joy overflowing uncontrollably.
But then she thought of something, and restrained herself again. She pursed her lips and pulled Li Chengfeng into the house, but when she was about to lift her steps, she remembered it and hurriedly spoke to Li Chengfeng, "Come on, Chengfeng, I'll help you. Let's carry this thing in together."
"Okay, thank you for your hard work, Miss."
Li Chengfeng looked at Yu Niang's appearance and spoke with a smile on his face. He also gathered strength as he spoke. He squatted down and carried the wild boar meat and the python carcass that were thrown on the ground into the yard with Liu Yu Niang.
After arriving at the courtyard, Liu Yuniang closed the courtyard door immediately, then walked over to Li Chengfeng and said with concern: "Chengfeng, are you thirsty? I'll get you a bowl of water."
"Okay."
Li Chengfeng smiled and nodded. He had drank all the two gourds of water he had brought with him in the mountains, and now he really felt thirsty. Hearing this, Liu Yuniang hurriedly poured a bowl of water and brought it to him.
Li Chengfeng took the water and drank it, and Liu Yuniang brought him a basin of water and a towel to wipe off the sweat and wash his face.
After finishing cleaning, he felt the heat surge in his waist, and the strength he had spent was restored, and he stood up immediately, "I have to clean up the pork quickly. The fat is refined into oil, and the lean meat is salted and reserved. Let's save some and eat it in the next few days. This pig is enough for us to eat for a while."
"Okay, let me help you."
Liu Yuniang spoke hurriedly, and was very positive when she heard that Li Chengfeng didn't want to go into the mountain.
"No, you should quickly take out the pig blood in the gourd and process it, so you can eat it as soon as possible."
Li Chengfeng shook his head, stood up and went to get the pot of water to boil. He looked at the wild boar carcass eagerly and said, "I'll take care of this wild boar. Just wait and help."
"Okay!"
When Liu Yuniang heard this, she also spoke enthusiastically. After speaking, she poured the pig's blood into a basin, mixed it with scallions and put it away.
After Li Chengfeng boiled the water and permed the hair on the wild boar skin, he took a hatchet and scraped the pig skin with him.
